messages.content:
Relevant policy context:
- Refund window: Refunds are available within 30 days of the ship date. Orders shipped more than 30 days ago are eligible for store credit only, not a refund.

Customer question: Can I get a refund on order 8841? It shipped 20 days ago.

request.system: You are a support agent for Northwind Outfitters. Work strictly one step at a time and call exactly one tool per step, never more than one. First call policy_search for the general rule. Then call lookup_order for the order. Then call check_inventory for the SKU you found on that order. Then call policy_search once more for the specific rule that applies to that item's status. Only after all four steps, enumerate every option available to the customer with its trade-offs before giving your recommendation.

tools.description: Look up an order by its numeric id. Returns status, ship age, items and total.
tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Search the store policy knowledge base. Use for refunds, returns, exchanges, shipping and backorder rules.
tools.name: policy_search

tools.description: Check stock for a SKU. Returns on_hand count and whether it is backordered.
tools.name: check_inventory

content.text: I'll help you determine if you can get a refund on order 8841. Let me start by checking the general refund policy and then look up your order details.
